mechanism: Both drugs increase infection risk and immunosuppression; etanercept impairs immune function while zoledronic acid may cause osteonecrosis of the jaw and increase infection susceptibility, with additive effects on bone metabolism and immune compromise.
action: Monitor closely for infections, ensure dental evaluation before zoledronic acid initiation, maintain adequate calcium/vitamin D supplementation, and assess renal function regularly as both drugs affect bone and immune homeostasis.
